title: Follow-Along Feature Reel Collision
description: Two women stand in the center of a flooded, ornate cinema hall as film reels, film strips and glowing particles explode around them. A large neon sign reading 'FOLLOW-ALONG FEATURE REEL COLLISION' hangs above them while a spotlight beam cuts through the decaying, vine-covered ceiling.
prompt: Two women stand back to back in a flooded ornate cinema with a collapsing ceiling, one wearing a black tactical outfit with a glowing blue chest device, the other in an elegant flowing burgundy gown, both with long dark hair flowing dramatically. Film reels, strips and golden particles explode outward from between them. A large broken neon sign above them reads 'FOLLOW-ALONG FEATURE REEL COLLISION' with vines growing over it. Spotlight beam from upper left, wet reflective floor, decaying classical architecture with frescoes, cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere.
